# Mutakamel Tenant Portal

Standalone Next.js tenant application replacing tenant-facing behavior in
../backend/mutakamel-apps/mutakamel-web-app.

Current application status: bootstrap only.
Documentation verification date: 2026-07-25.
Visual design documentation: intentionally excluded.

## Read first

- AGENTS.md
- docs/ai/START_HERE.md
- docs/DOCUMENTATION_CONTRACT.md
- docs/ai/SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md
- docs/app/replacement-scope.md
- docs/app/application-architecture.md
- docs/api/README.md
- docs/security/README.md
- docs/validation/README.md

## Browser API namespaces

- Core: /api/tenant/core/v1/*
- CRM: /api/tenant/crm/v1/*
- Trade: /api/tenant/trade/v1/*
- Worker: no direct tenant-browser API

The API Gateway is the only browser backend edge. Never call owning services
directly. Never modify ../backend from this project.

## Source precedence

1. Gateway typed route contracts
2. Owning controller and global/module guards
3. DTOs, enums, service/response contracts, entities, and tests
4. Old-web live clients and tests
5. Tenant Portal documentation
6. Mocks and comments, which are not contracts

## Machine-readable route evidence

- docs/generated/tenant-api-routes.json
- Generator: scripts/docs/generate-route-inventory.mjs

## Verification

From tenant-portal:

- npm run docs:routes
- npm run docs:check
- npm run lint
- npm run typecheck
- npm run build

Do not report a capability live until it exists in tenant-portal, uses the
server-backed contract, and has proportional tests.
